description: Plutus phase-2 differential family (cardano-node 11.1.2 vs Amaru 0925). Each case mints under a PlutusV3 policy and is phase-1-valid, so any reject is phase-2 (is_valid tag vs actual VM result). Oracle: verdict parity (one-accepts-one-rejects = real is_valid divergence) + phase-2 reason-class parity; MASKED/unavailable = inconclusive. exu-exact is built with the live-measured exact cost (64100,500) steps,mem. See workload/plutus_differential.py.

cases.note: is_valid=true, always-succeeds, declared ex-units = the EXACT cardano-computed cost (64100,500) steps,mem. KNIFE-EDGE: if amaru's computed cost differs by >=1, this is under-budget on amaru -> amaru rejects while cardano accepts = is_valid VERDICT-DIVERGENCE.
is_valid=true, always-succeeds, steps = exact-1 -> over budget -> script fails -> tag mismatch
is_valid=true, always-succeeds, mem = exact-1 -> over budget -> tag mismatch
is_valid=true, always-succeeds, ex-units (0,0) -> over budget -> tag mismatch
is_valid=true, always-succeeds, generous ex-units (<< maxTxExUnits) -> script succeeds -> accept
is_valid=FALSE but always-succeeds with ample budget -> script actually succeeds -> claimed-invalid contradicts reality -> tag mismatch (reject)
is_valid=FALSE, always-succeeds with (0,0) -> script fails on budget -> claim matches reality -> ACCEPT (collateral consumed)
is_valid=true, always-FAILS script -> script fails -> tag mismatch (reject)
is_valid=FALSE, always-FAILS script -> claim matches reality -> ACCEPT (collateral consumed)
